# Plan

Do mRNAs whose translation eIF3d promotes in MDA-MB-231 at hypoxia 1hr change in ribosome
occupancy or TE when METTL13 (the eEF1A K55 dimethyltransferase) is knocked out in T3M4 cells?

**Groups.**

- **eIF3d-promoted** (orange): the classifier's 1,436 positives. TE log2(sictrl / si3d) > 0.5,
  padj < 0.05, hypoxia 1hr.
- **Negative control** (black): the classifier's size-matched seed-9 draw of 1,436 genes from
  `negative_control_genes.csv`. A screened set, chosen for having no eIF3d effect.
- **All other measured genes** (grey): every other gene in the Liu results.

**Readouts**, from `05_riboseq_deseq2.Rmd`, both **log2(sgControl / sgMETTL13), positive =
METTL13 promotes**:

- **(A) Ribo LFC as saved** (apeglm-shrunken). The reliable readout in this dataset.
- **(B) TE LFC, unshrunken.** Shrunken TE is ~0 for nearly every gene, because the RNA arm
  does not replicate (`05_` replicate-concordance section). Treat (B) as a noisy ranking.

# Load the Liu ribo-seq results

```{r load_liu}
liu_csv <- here("output", "translational_control_overview", "liu2026_eef1a_k55me2",
                "translation_categories_sgcontrol_vs_sgmettl13_liu2026.csv")
if (!file.exists(liu_csv)) stop("Run 05_riboseq_deseq2.Rmd first: ", liu_csv, " not found")
liu <- read_csv(liu_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot(all(c("gene_id", "ribo_lfc", "te_lfc_mle") %in% names(liu)),
          !anyDuplicated(liu$gene_id),
          all(is.finite(liu$ribo_lfc)), all(is.finite(liu$te_lfc_mle)))

# Direction: METTL13 is knocked out, so it must be positive in log2(sgControl / sgMETTL13)
mettl13_ribo <- liu$ribo_lfc[liu$gene_id == "METTL13"]
cat("Genes:", nrow(liu), "| METTL13 ribo_lfc:", round(mettl13_ribo, 2), "\n")
stopifnot("METTL13 ribo_lfc not positive - Liu contrast direction flipped" = mettl13_ribo > 1)
```

# Load the classifier's gene sets

```{r load_sets}
out_tco  <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
sets_csv <- file.path(out_tco, paste0("rf_model_gene_sets_", params$model_suffix, ".csv"))
stopifnot("model gene-set CSV not found - knit 02_rf_model.Rmd with these params" =
            file.exists(sets_csv))
model_sets <- read_csv(sets_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

pos_genes <- model_sets$gene_id_clean[model_sets$eif3d_target == "promotes"]
neg_genes <- model_sets$gene_id_clean[model_sets$eif3d_target == "does_not_promote"]
stopifnot(length(pos_genes) == 1436L, length(neg_genes) == 1436L,
          length(intersect(pos_genes, neg_genes)) == 0,
          !anyNA(model_sets$symbol), !anyDuplicated(model_sets$symbol))
```

## Check: the saved negatives are the seed-9 draw

Rebuilt exactly as `02_rf_model.Rmd`'s `create_target` chunk does.

```{r rederive_draw}
matrix_genes <- readRDS(file.path(out_tco, params$matrix_rds))$gene_id_clean
pos_csv  <- read_csv(here("output", "genesets", "hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv"),
                     show_col_types = FALSE)
neg_pool <- read_csv(here("output", "predictive_modeling", "negative_control_genes.csv"),
                     show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))

pos_in <- pos_csv %>% filter(ensembl_gene %in% matrix_genes)
pool   <- neg_pool %>% filter(gene_id_clean %in% matrix_genes, !gene_id_clean %in% pos_in$ensembl_gene)

set.seed(params$neg_seed)
redrawn <- sample(pool$gene_id_clean, min(nrow(pos_in), nrow(pool)))

stopifnot("positives are not the gene-set CSV intersected with the matrix" =
            setequal(pos_in$ensembl_gene, pos_genes),
          "re-derived seed-9 draw does not reproduce the saved negatives" =
            setequal(redrawn, neg_genes))
cat("Seed", params$neg_seed, "draw reproduced: all", length(neg_genes), "negatives match\n")
```

## Check: direction of the eIF3d contrast

The MDA-MB-231 TE files are log2(sictrl / si3d) despite their filename. EIF3D's own RNA must be
strongly positive, every positive must have TE LFC > 0.5, and every negative |TE LFC| < 0.5.

```{r direction}
te <- read_csv(here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
               show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))

eif3d_rna <- te$rna_lfc[te$symbol == "EIF3D"]
cat("EIF3D rna_lfc at hypoxia 1hr:", round(eif3d_rna, 2), "\n")
stopifnot("EIF3D rna_lfc not strongly positive - contrast direction flipped" =
            length(eif3d_rna) == 1 && eif3d_rna > 2)

te_pos <- te %>% filter(gene_id_clean %in% pos_genes)
te_neg <- te %>% filter(gene_id_clean %in% neg_genes)
stopifnot(nrow(te_pos) == length(pos_genes), nrow(te_neg) == length(neg_genes),
          all(te_pos$te_lfc > 0.5), all(te_pos$te_padj < 0.05),
          all(abs(te_neg$te_lfc) < 0.5))
```

# Match set genes to Liu genes

Liu's genes are RefSeq symbols; ours carry GENCODE v49 symbols. Match on symbol. An alias
fallback (`org.Hs.eg.db` aliases of unmatched set genes) was tested and rescued **no**
genes: the unmatched ones (e.g. BMAL2/ARNTL2, RIGI/DDX58, NHERF2/SLC9A3R2) are absent from
Liu's file under both names, and a loose alias rule instead produced false matches to other
real genes (PHF1 to PHF2, MRPL23 to RPL23). So symbol matching only.

```{r match}
sets <- model_sets %>%
  mutate(group = if_else(eif3d_target == "promotes", "eIF3d-promoted", "Negative control")) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol, group)

raw_genes <- read.delim(here("accessories", "liu2026_GSE335287_raw_counts.txt"))$geneID

sets %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(n_set = n(),
            in_liu_results    = sum(symbol %in% liu$gene_id),
            removed_by_filter = sum(symbol %in% raw_genes & !symbol %in% liu$gene_id),
            absent_from_file  = sum(!symbol %in% raw_genes),
            fraction_in_liu   = mean(symbol %in% liu$gene_id)) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)

matched <- sets %>% filter(symbol %in% liu$gene_id) %>% dplyr::rename(liu_gene = symbol)
```

The negative controls are less often measured in T3M4 than the promoted set (more fall below
the expression filter), so the plotted groups are no longer size-matched. That is reported,
not corrected.

# CDFs

```{r cdf_function}
grp_levels <- c("eIF3d-promoted", "Negative control", "All other genes")
grp_colors <- c("eIF3d-promoted" = "#E69F00", "Negative control" = "black",
                "All other genes" = "grey70")

plot_df <- liu %>%
  left_join(matched %>% dplyr::select(liu_gene, group), by = c("gene_id" = "liu_gene")) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(replace_na(group, "All other genes"), levels = grp_levels))

cdf_plot <- function(col, xlab, title) {
  x  <- split(plot_df[[col]], plot_df$group)
  n  <- lengths(x)[grp_levels]
  w  <- list(pn = wilcox.test(x[["eIF3d-promoted"]],   x[["Negative control"]]),
             po = wilcox.test(x[["eIF3d-promoted"]],   x[["All other genes"]]),
             no = wilcox.test(x[["Negative control"]], x[["All other genes"]]))
  labs_n <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n = %s)", grp_levels, trimws(format(n, big.mark = ","))), grp_levels)
  stats <- tibble(comparison = c("promoted vs neg ctrl", "promoted vs other", "neg ctrl vs other"),
                  wilcoxon_p = map_dbl(w, "p.value"))
  meds  <- map_dbl(x, median)[grp_levels]

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(.data[[col]], colour = group)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.8) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = quantile(plot_df[[col]], c(0.005, 0.995))) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = grp_colors, labels = labs_n, breaks = grp_levels, name = NULL) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.6, size = 3.2,
             label = sprintf("promoted vs neg ctrl: Wilcoxon p = %s\nmedian %.3f vs %.3f",
                             format.pval(w$pn$p.value, digits = 2),
                             meds[["eIF3d-promoted"]], meds[["Negative control"]])) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Cumulative fraction", title = title,
         subtitle = "Groups: eIF3d TE, MDA-MB-231 hypoxia 1hr") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.02, 0.98), legend.justification = c(0, 1),
          legend.background = element_blank())
  list(plot = p, stats = stats, medians = meds)
}
```

## (A) Ribo LFC (shrunken, as saved)

```{r cdf_ribo, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4.5}
cdf_ribo <- cdf_plot("ribo_lfc",
                     "Ribo log2(sgControl / sgMETTL13), positive = METTL13 promotes",
                     "METTL13 KO ribosome occupancy (Liu 2026, T3M4)")
cdf_ribo$plot
knitr::kable(cdf_ribo$stats, digits = 4)
knitr::kable(enframe(cdf_ribo$medians, "group", "median_ribo_lfc"), digits = 3)

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_06_cdf_ribo_eif3d_promoted_hypoxia_1hr.pdf"), cdf_ribo$plot,
         width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
```

## (B) TE LFC (unshrunken)

```{r cdf_te, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4.5}
cdf_te <- cdf_plot("te_lfc_mle",
                   "TE log2(sgControl / sgMETTL13), unshrunken; positive = METTL13 promotes",
                   "METTL13 KO TE (Liu 2026, T3M4)")
cdf_te$plot
knitr::kable(cdf_te$stats, digits = 4)
knitr::kable(enframe(cdf_te$medians, "group", "median_te_lfc_mle"), digits = 3)

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_06_cdf_te_unshrunken_eif3d_promoted_hypoxia_1hr.pdf"), cdf_te$plot,
         width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
```

## (C) TE LFC (shrunken, as saved)

apeglm shrinks the TE LFC to ~0 for nearly every gene (the Liu RNA arm does not replicate), so
nearly every gene sits within about +/-5e-6. The axis is zoomed to that range; these
differences are far too small to mean anything biologically. Shown for comparison with (B).

```{r cdf_te_shrunken, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4.5}
cat("Genes with |shrunken TE LFC| < 0.01:", sum(abs(plot_df$te_lfc) < 0.01), "of", nrow(plot_df), "\n")
cdf_te_shr <- cdf_plot("te_lfc",
                       "TE log2(sgControl / sgMETTL13), shrunken; positive = METTL13 promotes",
                       "METTL13 KO TE, shrunken (Liu 2026, T3M4)")
# Shrunken values sit within about +/-5e-6 (99% of genes); zoom there, axis in units of 1e-6
cdf_te_shr$plot <- cdf_te_shr$plot +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-6e-6, 6e-6)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) x * 1e6) +
  labs(x = "TE log2(sgControl / sgMETTL13), shrunken, x 1e-6\npositive = METTL13 promotes")
cdf_te_shr$plot
knitr::kable(cdf_te_shr$stats, digits = 4)
knitr::kable(enframe(cdf_te_shr$medians, "group", "median_te_lfc_shrunken"), digits = 5)

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_06_cdf_te_shrunken_eif3d_promoted_hypoxia_1hr.pdf"), cdf_te_shr$plot, width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
```
